svg.text: 1. redirect in EX: fetch the target
2. load-use stall: hold PC and IF/ID
3. stop word in ID: hold PC, bubble IF/ID
the PC holds, IF/ID takes bubbles;
older instructions drain, and the run
ends when the stop word reaches WB
an illegal word) moves from ID to EX
id_stop, and no stall, no redirect
next_pc = rst ? RESET_ADDR : flush ? redirect_pc : (stall | id_stop | fetch_stopped) ? pc : pc + 4
